title: DigiMoi
heading: DigiMoi user guide
summary: Record every moi (gift) at your function: helpers record from their own phones or guests write their own by QR, thank every giver on WhatsApp, share live totals with family, and keep track of the moi you have to return.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.text: Open the website, click Try Demo and choose DigiMoi. Your account is free for 7 days.
points: Fill in your name and mobile number, tap Send OTP and enter the code you receive. Choose a password and tap Register.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.text: Use the same mobile number and password on the website and in the Android app.
points: Your 10 digit mobile number.
Your password.
Tap Sign In.

steps.title: Your dashboard
steps.text: After you sign in you see the totals for your active function: amount received, expenses, number of entries and places. The quick actions take you straight to the screens you use most.

steps.title: Add your function
steps.text: Open Masters → Function Master. Every wedding, ear piercing or house warming is a separate function with its own entries and reports.
points: Enter the function name, date, hall and the names of the people the function is for. The message is printed on the reports.
Tap Save. A new function becomes your active function straight away.

steps.title: Switch to another function
steps.text: The green card is the function your entries are saved to. To work on a different one, tap Use this function on its card. Tap the pencil to change a function's details.
points: Use this function makes that function active for receipts, expenses, handover and reports.

steps.title: Add helpers
steps.text: Open Masters → User Master to add the people who will record moi at the counter. Each helper signs in on their own phone and their entries go to your active function.
points: Enter the helper's name, mobile number and a password.
Tap Save, then share the mobile number and password with the helper.

steps.title: Record a moi
steps.text: Open Transactions → New Receipt. Press Enter to move to the next field, so you can record quickly without the mouse.
points: Village or place of the person.
Their name. Add the surname, mobile and remarks if you have them.
New Amount is the moi given today. Old Amount is for a moi you are returning from an earlier function.
Tap Save. The entry appears under Recently Saved Transaction with the running total.

steps.title: Type by voice or in your language
steps.text: Every field has a microphone. Tap it and speak the name or place. Turn on Spelling suggestions to type in English letters and pick the word in Tamil or your language.
points: Tap the microphone and speak.

steps.title: Say the whole entry in one go
steps.text: On New Receipt tap Speak whole entry and say the place, name and amount together, for example "காரைக்குடி முருகன் ஐயாயிரத்து ஒன்று". DigiMoi fills in the fields for you to check, then tap Save.
points: Works in Tamil, English, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam.
If something is missing, DigiMoi tells you which field to fill.

steps.title: Import a written moi list
steps.text: Have the moi written in a notebook? Tap Import on the New Receipt screen and choose From a photo. Upload a clear photo (JPEG or PNG) of the list and the app reads the entries for you. Check them, correct anything that was misread, then save. You can also choose Type entries to add several at once.
points: Import opens the photo upload.

steps.title: Find and correct an entry
steps.text: Open Transactions → Receipt List. Search by name, place or mobile number.
points: Type a name, place or mobile and tap Search.
The pencil opens the entry to correct it. The bin removes it.

steps.title: Edit an entry
steps.text: Change the details and tap Save. The totals update straight away.

steps.title: Record expenses
steps.text: Open Transactions → New Expenses for money spent on the function: catering, decoration, hall, photography and more.
points: Choose the category and enter who was paid and the amount.
Tap Save.

steps.title: Record gold and other gifts
steps.text: Open Transactions → Add Others for gifts that are not cash, such as rings, chains, coins and anklets.
points: Choose the type of gift.
Enter how many. Add the weight or details in Others Remarks.
Type the weight in grams too, so the gold value can be worked out.

steps.title: Show the guest QR
steps.text: On New Receipt tap Guest QR. Print the poster and keep it at the moi counter, or show it on a phone.
points: Only the owner sees New QR. A new QR stops the old one and its printed copies.

steps.title: What the guest sees
steps.text: The guest scans the QR, picks a language, and types or speaks their place, name and amount. They choose Cash at the counter or UPI.
points: For UPI the page shows the family's UPI QR with the amount filled in. After paying, the guest can type the UPI reference.

steps.title: Accept guest entries
steps.text: Open Transactions → Guest entries. Check each entry, fix spelling if needed, and tap Accept to add it as a receipt, or Reject.
points: For UPI, accept only after the money shows in the family's bank or UPI app. If unsure, ask the account owner.
The list refreshes every 10 seconds.

steps.title: Family live link
steps.text: On the dashboard tap Family live link and set a 4 to 6 digit PIN. Share the link on WhatsApp and send the PIN separately. Family abroad or elders at home see the total, the count and the latest gifts, live.
points: Change the PIN or turn the link off at any time.

steps.title: Invitations and RSVP
steps.text: Open Transactions → Invitations. Share the invitation on WhatsApp or print its QR. Guests reply coming or not, with how many people, so you know how many to cook for.

steps.title: See what each helper collected
steps.text: Open Transactions → HandOver. Each row shows what one person received, spent and collected as other gifts, and the amount they should hand over.
points: Tap HandOver on a person's row when they give you the money.

steps.title: Record the handover
steps.text: Enter the amount handed over and who received it. If the amount is less than expected, the difference is shown so you can sort it out on the spot. Tap Save.

steps.title: Thank every giver on WhatsApp
steps.text: Open Transactions → Thank givers. Tap Send next: WhatsApp opens with the giver's name and amount filled in. Send, come back, and tap Send next again.
points: Choose Tamil or English and edit the message once; it is used for everyone.
Only givers with a mobile number are listed.

steps.title: Print the moi book and thank-you cards
steps.text: Open Transactions → Moi book. Print the list village by village with old and new moi and totals, like the family notebook. Print thank-you cards for every giver, with or without the amount.

steps.title: Gold value
steps.text: On the dashboard tap Gold value and enter today's gold rate per gram. Gold gifts with a weight are valued and added to the moi total; switch between grams and pavun.

steps.title: Plan the moi you will give
steps.text: When you get an invitation, open Moi to return and tap Add invitation. As you type the name, DigiMoi shows what that person gave at your functions and what you gave them before.
points: Tap Remind me to add the date to your Google Calendar.
After the function tap Mark given; it is added to Moi we gave.

steps.title: Import old moi notebooks
steps.text: Open Old moi notebooks, add a past function, then add photos of its notebook pages. AI reads the entries; check them and tap Save entries. Moi to return then knows who gave what, even years ago.
points: Comes with the Standard and Premium plans.
These entries do not count toward the free plan's 100 entries.

steps.title: Download reports as PDF or Excel
steps.text: Open Reports. The Income, Expense, Others and Regional reports can be searched and downloaded. The PDF prints names in Tamil and the other languages correctly.
points: Excel downloads every entry as a spreadsheet.
PDF downloads a print-ready report with your function details.

steps.title: Summary report
steps.text: The Summary Report shows the whole function at a glance: received, spent, other gifts and the balance for each person who recorded entries.

steps.title: Install the Android app
steps.text: Open the Get the app page on your phone and tap Download. Open the downloaded MySuccess.apk and allow your browser to install it. Sign in with the same mobile number and password. On a computer you can send the link to your phone on WhatsApp.

steps.title: Choose a plan
steps.text: The first 7 days are free with up to 100 entries. Then choose Standard (₹99 a month) or Premium (₹199 a month) on the Pricing page, DigiMoi tab. Pay once, or use AutoPay.
points: Only one function this year? When the free limit is reached you can pay ₹299 once for that function instead: unlimited entries until 60 days after the function.

steps.title: Earn as a DigiMoi partner
steps.text: Printers, function organisers, halls and shops can open Partner dashboard and apply. Once approved you get a code, a link and a QR. Families who sign up from it are counted for you, and you earn a share of what they pay.
